subject: Temporal handoff proposal for dedicated/private deployment review
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Novak <elena.novak@orbitalhealth.com>, Luca Romano <luca.romano@medsys.co>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Temporal handoff proposal for dedicated/private deployment review

Hi Elena / Luca —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our run-through, the deployment review requires short, focused stakeholder calls with your EU DPO and your APAC security lead to sign off on the privacy & network controls for the dedicated/private deployment. Because stakeholders span US/EU/APAC and DST boundaries, I wanted to propose a compact cadence that reduces finger-pointing on dates and minimizes extra travel windows.

Proposal (high level):
- Two 30-min segments on the same UTC-aligned day: 08:00–08:30 UTC (APAC-focused, late morning for APAC reviewers) and 14:00–14:30 UTC (EU/US overlap, for DPO + engineering).
- Each segment has a 10-min buffer and a shared 15-min overlap for handoff notes captured in a single shared doc.
- Internal Redwood reviewers: Ben (security runtime), Marissa (private deploy lead), Vivek (ops).
- External reviewers: Elena — please confirm EU DPO attendee and whether 14:00 UTC works for them; Luca — can you confirm APAC contact and whether they can join the earlier slot?

Attached is a short agenda + a proposed rolling cadence ICS. I tried to align with DST transitions (we kept times in UTC to avoid local clock confusion). If a single continuous hour works better for your org, we can run a contiguous session with breakouts.

Attachments: MMP_v2_agenda.pdf (quick agenda), proposed_cadence.ics

Next steps: Please reply with availability or suggest two concrete 30-min windows in UTC this week or next.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Redwood Inference | https://redwood.ai
From: Elena Novak <elena.novak@orbitalhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: EU DPO <dpo@orbitalhealth.com>, Luca Romano <luca.romano@medsys.co>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:10:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Temporal handoff proposal for dedicated/private deployment review

Naomi —

Appreciate the clear proposal. 14:00 UTC looks fine for our EU DPO for the second segment (that is 16:00 CEST here). For the APAC portion: our APAC compliance lead is based in SG but coordinates with MedSys in Tokyo — Luca, would Hiro be able to join the earlier 08:00 UTC slot? (08:00 UTC is 17:00 SGT / 18:00 JST).

Two quick asks from Orbital Health:
- Can we get a short pre-read (one pager) that calls out network egress expectations and retention windows for key artifacts?
- Please include the DPO's preferred redaction checklist so we can pre-run a quick privacy check.

If you can provide the pre-read and a calendar hold, we can confirm internally by Monday.

Best,
Elena
Director of IT & Cloud Programs
Orbital Health

On Sat, May 15, 2027 at 09:10 +0200, Elena Novak wrote:
> Naomi —
> 
> Appreciate the clear proposal. 14:00 UTC looks fine for our EU DPO for the second segment...

Thanks Elena — quick follow-up from the Redwood side. Naomi and I talked through options and recommend the split-session with a short overlap for two reasons: it lets APAC reviewers see the runtime configuration live and gives the DPO a clean chunk focused on data access, policy and retention.

Operational detail we propose (attached roster):
- Day-of schedule (UTC): 08:00–08:30 (APAC deep-dive, infra + networking), 08:30–08:45 (buffer/notes capture), 14:00–14:30 (DPO review + legal), 14:30–14:45 (buffer/next steps).
- Required attendees: APAC Sec Lead (Hiro Tanaka / hiro.tanaka@medsys.co), EU DPO (dpo@orbitalhealth.com), Redwood: Ben, Marissa, Vivek, Naomi.
- Pre-read: 1-page network egress + retention summary (I attached a baseline XLSX you can use to confirm row-level items).

Attachments: regional_review_roster.xlsx (attendee roster + responsibilities)

If that works, Naomi — can you send the calendar holds in UTC and link a shared drive doc for notes? We should also mark the calendar invites as private for the DPO attendee.

—Ben

Senior Security PM, Redwood Inference

Perfect — thank you all for the quick responses. Action items and confirmations below: 

1) Confirmed slots: we will hold the two-segment cadence on the following UTC times (please confirm one date preference):
   - Slot A (APAC deep-dive): 08:00–08:30 UTC (17:00 SGT / 18:00 JST)
   - Slot B (DPO review): 14:00–14:30 UTC (16:00 CEST)

2) Pre-read & checklist: Ben has attached the roster; I uploaded a one-pager (MMP_v2_agenda.pdf) and a short retention/KMS summary to the shared drive (link below). Luca — thanks in advance for the KMS sentence; we will incorporate it into the pre-read.

3) Calendar invites: I created ICS holds and set visibility to private for the DPO attendee. Invites include a shared meeting notes doc and a link to the agenda. Please accept or propose an alternate date in the calendar.

4) Notes on DST: because local clocks vary, all invites and the shared doc will reference UTC start times; we'll include a small timezone conversion table in the meeting notes.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMMP-v2, https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/D-4381

Attachments included in calendar invite: proposed_cadence.ics, MMP_v2_agenda.pdf, regional_review_roster.xlsx

Next step: Elena / DPO — please confirm preferred date (we've suggested two candidate dates in the ICS next week). Once you confirm, we'll finalize invites and a short runbook for the review call.
